system_fit.fallback: xMins/usage proxy; no unsupported formation-role claim

rotation_competition.fallback: bench/DNP distribution proxy for competition and rotation

set_piece_role.fallback: neutral set-piece adjustment when player-specific role evidence is unavailable

penalty_role.fallback: neutral penalty adjustment when player-specific role evidence is unavailable

sustainability.fallback: shrunk rate bundle with explicit prior provenance

bonus_route.fallback: shrunk bonus-rate estimate; Official bonus remains scoring authority

european_congestion.fallback: congestion_factor=1.0 when no verified European schedule signal is integrated

domestic_cup_congestion.fallback: congestion_factor=1.0 when no verified domestic-cup schedule signal is integrated

international_load.fallback: congestion_factor=1.0 when no verified international-load signal is integrated

rest_days.fallback: fixture ordering retained; no unsupported fatigue penalty when kickoff evidence is insufficient

preseason_prior.fallback: historical/current-season/position prior only; preseason signal is neutral when unavailable

historical_prior.fallback: position prior for unmatched players; missing player history is never fabricated

regression_risk.fallback: small-sample and uncertainty guards remain active before settled calibration data exists

price_value.fallback: Official current price divided against governed multi-GW projection

ownership_context.fallback: Official selected-by percentage; EO is not invented when unavailable

transfer_momentum.fallback: no momentum inference when Official transfer counts or current-price linkage are insufficient

learning_loop.fallback: ARMED_NO_SETTLED_SAMPLE until a reconciled post-GW sample exists

bench_utility.fallback: governed bench ordering and autosub utility

captaincy.fallback: governed captain safe-pool with DNP guard
